review_notes: I read the whole file. It has one new definition, `modl`. It is the character value η(-(c·(X0i·X0j + X1i·X1j))), a problem-specific modulation factor. Mathlib has no concept that corresponds to it. All other declarations are theorems. Under the rubric, theorem-level duplication such as `mul_transvection_apply` is excluded, and so is proof shortening. The file builds on the existing `colFourier23`, `matFourier23`, `IsSchwartzBruhat`, `selfDualHaarAt`, `Matrix.transvection` and `AddChar`, and it does not define competing versions of them. I did not search Mathlib exhaustively for near-duplicates of `modl`, because it is too specific to match a Mathlib concept.
